title: Senior Technical Program Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><strong>📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰Competitive base salary and stock options |<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits</a></strong></p> <p>At Monzo, our mission is to make money work for everyone, everywhere. We’re looking for Senior Technical Program Managers to join our Engineering teams across Payments and Business Banking, helping us deliver complex, high-impact programmes as we continue to grow.</p> <p>Depending on the team you join, you could be:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Payments</strong>: helping us ship more and better payment products, working across teams to solve complex technical challenges and improve how money moves for millions of customers.</li> <li><strong>Business Banking</strong>: helping us build Monzo into the financial control centre for SMEs. You’ll work across teams to deliver features, services and integrations that make running a business simpler from invoicing and expenses to payments and automation.</li> </ul> <p>Both roles have a wide remit and involve working across engineering, product and other teams at Monzo. We’re looking for people who can bring clarity to complex technical programmes, influence across teams and help turn ambitious ideas into meaningful outcomes for our customers.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead end-to-end planning and execution of launching payment products that cross multiple teams and disciplines</li> <li>Manage cross-collective programs: <ul> <li>Define program roadmaps and milestones, set priorities, manage trade-offs, identify and manage critical path and risks, ensure alignment with the business goals and ambition</li> <li>Collaborate and communicate with multiple stakeholders, both technical and non-technical across the business to ensure alignment and speed of delivery</li> <li>Manage dependencies, timeline and sequencing of delivery</li> </ul> </li> <li>Drive effective decision making to remove blockers and speed up delivery</li> <li>Ensure operational effectiveness across your collective/area</li> </ul> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have 5+ years of experience managing complex technology programs or products from inception to launch</li> <li>You are able to communicate clearly and persuasively to a wide range of audiences, including executive leadership</li> <li>You are comfortable in a global business with a presence in multiple markets and want to be a part of scaling this further</li> <li>You can work effectively with a diverse range of people and working styles to get stuff done, and are able to thoughtfully and constructively challenge and influence the people you work with</li> <li>You understand how functionality comes together (across products and platforms) to deliver value for users, and identify/mitigate delivery risks proactively; can propose and drive a technical solution</li> <li>You are comfortable personally diving deep into the data and architecture to make good decisions in complex situations where there’s often no “right answer”</li> </ul> <p><strong>The interview process:</strong></p> <ol> <li><strong>Recruiter Call (30 mins)</strong> You'll meet our Engineering Leadership Recruiter to discuss your experience and learn more about Monzo. They'll be your partner and guide throughout the interview process.</li> <li><strong>Initial Call (45 mins)</strong> You'll meet with one of our engineering leaders. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular program execution and technical leadership. They’ll also make time to tell you about Monzo and answer your questions.</li> <li><strong>Loop Stage (3 hours)</strong> The Loop stage consists of 3 x 60 min interviews that take place over 1-2 days (depending on your availability).</li> </ol> <p>All things going well, you'll have completed the hiring process 🚀</p> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You’ll have the chance to speak to our recruitment team throughout the process. If you’d like to ask a question sooner, email <a href="mailto:tech-hiring@monzo.com">tech-hiring@monzo.com</a></p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <p>💰Base salary range for this role is dependent on experience + equity + stock options & benefits</p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"><strong>here</strong></a></p> <p>#LI-SS1</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: VP of Sales, EMEA
description: A little about us incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Netflix, Etsy, and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime. The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously. We've raised $96 million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join. The role in one line This is the seat where EMEA goes from early traction to a real engine: you own the number, you build the team, and you stay close enough to the deals to feel every one of them. What that looks like day to day Our GTM team is growing quickly. In London we already have pods across Enterprise Sales, Commercial Sales, Customer Success, BDR and Solutions Engineering, with a mix of internally promoted and externally hired first-line and segment leaders in place. You own the EMEA revenue number, including new business and the bulk of net retention across Commercial, Mid-Market and Enterprise. You lead the EMEA sales org directly, setting the bar on hiring, performance, coaching and territory design. You partner with in-region CS, SE, BDR and expansion account management to make the full regional motion work. This is not a role you can do from behind a forecast. You'll be in the deals, running exec-level conversations with CTOs, CIOs and CISOs, inspecting and coaching pipeline personally, and carrying the deals that need you. You'll also drive operational excellence across pipeline reviews, forecast calls, QBRs, recruiting, enablement, fiscal planning and territory design. Our leaders are close to the product, close to customers, and close to cross-functional peers. You'll work closely with our founders, COO, CMO, VP Finance, RevOps and Product, and build trust with Engineering, Marketing, Finance and company leadership. What you hear in region should influence the roadmap, and you'll contribute to company-wide planning and exec discussions, helping shape our global growth trajectory. We want a real point of view on AI in GTM. How your team prospects, researches, qualifies, forecasts and closes should look different because of it. You also set the cultural tone in London: a high performance bar, and a culture people want to be part of. Who you are You're based in or around London, and you're up for travelling across EMEA and occasionally to the US. You've built an EMEA revenue engine from roughly $XXM to $XXXM at a high-growth B2B software company, and you have the appetite and resilience to take us from early traction to sustained scale in a Series B environment. You've built and scaled sales teams across Commercial, Mid-Market and Enterprise, and you know how the motion, hiring bar and cadence differ across each. You're hands-on. You still get into deals, run discovery, coach live calls and hold a point of view on the product. You're not two layers removed from the customer. You understand technical sales and have a track record selling to CTOs, CIOs and CISOs. You have a real point of view on leveraging AI in GTM, grounded in things you've actually rolled out rather than things you've read about. You keep a high performance bar while building a culture aligned with our values. We want both, and candidates who can only do one are not a fit. You're also an exceptional recruiter who attracts and retains A-players, and people follow you. You build trust extensively across Engineering, Product and company leadership, and you're operationally excellent, with a bias for clarity, measurement and predictable execution. Bonus points if you have experience scaling footprint into other European markets such as France, DACH and the Nordics. VP of EMEA Sales experience at a high-growth SaaS company scaling from $XXM to $XXXM+ is a plus, as is senior regional leadership at a $10B+ B2B software company with material revenue responsibility. We'd also love experience selling to engineering and SRE buyers in the reliability, observability, monitoring or DevOps space, early channel and alliances go-to-market experience, and the ability to lead cross-cultural teams across Europe. Supporting you We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both. Private medical insurance. Seriously good cover - we want you and the people you love to be looked after. Competitive annual leave. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that. First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously. Enhanced pension. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought. Meaningful equity. We're rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it. Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too. Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them. Two budgets that have your back. £1000 to invest in your setup, £500 a year to invest in yourself. Compensation: £185K – £200K • Offers Equity • Offers Commission • £185K – £200K • Offers Equity • Offers Commission Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

We are looking for a Global Director of Product for Flex to lead the product strategy, direction, and organisation behind Kraken's global flexibility platform. Kraken Flex connects distributed energy resources to energy markets at scale — operating across Liberalised Markets, where we trade flexibility directly, and Regulated Markets, where we partner with utilities and DSOs to deliver grid services. This is a pivotal executive product role at the heart of Kraken's fastest-growing business unit. You will own the product direction, roadmap, culture, and delivery effectiveness of the shared Flex platform — the core set of capabilities that both business units depend on to compete and grow. Your mandate is to evolve the Flex platform into a scalable, differentiated capability that creates long-term strategic advantage: meaningfully ahead of anything the flexibility market has built. 🏡 Where you'll fit in: You will lead the product organisation across all shared Flex platform squads — the teams building the core capabilities that underpin Liberalised and Regulated Markets propositions globally. The shared platform sits at the intersection of two distinct business models, multiple geographies, and a constantly evolving set of market requirements. The central challenge of this role is making the right calls about what the platform should build, in what sequence, and why — while holding the tension between serving immediate business needs and protecting long-term platform integrity. 🚀 What you'll own: Product Strategy and Roadmap: Own the product vision and roadmap across all Flex platform squads. Ensure the shared platform evolves toward reusable, composable architecture — balancing immediate delivery needs with long-term platform coherence. Platform Product Expertise: Deep experience in platform or shared infrastructure product contexts — building capabilities that serve multiple internal customers with competing priorities, without losing coherence or quality. Commercial Acumen: A track record of connecting product decisions to business outcomes and making the case for long-term platform investment in commercial terms. You can represent product strategy credibly to executive leadership. Engineering Partnership: Genuine experience co-owning roadmaps and co-building organisations with engineering leadership as a peer — not a handoff relationship. Organisational Complexity: Demonstrated ability to operate across multiple business units, market models, or geographies — making decisions that serve the whole without losing sight of the specific. Leadership & Mindset You possess a rare combination of strategic clarity and operational discipline — you can define where the platform needs to be in three years while staying close enough to delivery to know when something's going wrong today. You are a product leader who builds organisations, not just products. The PMs around you get better because of you. You thrive in environments where the answer isn't obvious. You can hold the tension between serving immediate business needs and protecting long-term platform integrity, and make good decisions in that space. title: Head of Engineering - Optimisation & Control
description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. 🏡 Where you'll fit in: KrakenFlex is the flexibility arm of the Kraken group, built to put a big green dent in global carbon emissions by rewriting how electricity grids operate. We stabilize the grid and help renewables come online much faster by managing the second-by-second balance of clean power. Right now, our platform connects nearly one million assets worldwide, putting over 6GW of live load under our direct control. Behind the scenes, that means handling massive technical scale: solving complex optimization problems in real time and processing 15 billion data readings a day from the latest green technologies, ensuring the grid stays reliable without relying on old fossil-fuel backup plants. The next phase of our journey involves monumental growth. Currently operational across multiple countries, we are poised for further global expansion, scaling our asset base and tackling unique grid challenges in new territories. Our mission is to integrate an increasingly diverse array of green flexibility assets while ensuring our market-leading platform remains exceptionally stable and performant. What is Optimisation in Flex? The Optimisation chapter is the mathematical and algorithmic engine of the KrakenFlex platform. While other chapters manage physical asset connectivity or ingest market signals, this domain is responsible for the intelligence that decides exactly what every asset should do, second by second, to maximise both grid stability and financial returns. The teams within this chapter build and maintain the real-time dispatch engines, predictive forecasting models, and algorithmic solvers that handle massive multi-asset portfolios. This involves translating complex market rules, physical asset constraints (like battery degradation curves, state-of-charge limits, and ramp rates), and fluctuating price signals into optimised execution strategies. The defining challenge for this chapter is scaling computational performance alongside our rapid asset growth. Running complex, multi-variable mathematical models in tight real-time windows requires immense efficiency. The core tension lies in balancing the demand from data science and quantitative engineering to introduce increasingly sophisticated models with the strict platform requirement for absolute reliability, low latency, and cost-effective cloud compute. Ultimately, this chapter must move away from bespoke optimisation routines tailored to individual markets or asset types. Your goal is to architect a highly performant, modular optimisation core that uses standard abstract layers, allowing us to roll out new algorithms or expand into new global territories without rewriting the underlying engine. 🚀 What you’ll own: The Flex platform is built on autonomous Chapters, which are collections of specialists focused on delivering a core service or business outcome, defined by the unchanging nature of the energy business (independent of technology, hardware, or regional differences). A Head of Engineering leading a Chapter is a senior leadership role combining strong product thinking, engineering judgement, operational awareness, and people leadership. They manage managers and senior individual contributors, helping teams own their product surfaces, make sound trade-offs, and deliver reliably. This role requires influencing beyond its formal remit, spotting cross-team patterns, clarifying ownership and decision-making, and driving initiatives to turn recurring issues into visible actions with owners, dates, and measures of success. Ultimately, they maintain the technical vision for their specific area, ensuring services are appropriately owned, maintained, and aligned with Flex's sustainable growth. Managing the leads. Maintaining the technical vision for a given area. The overall team architecture Ensuring the services in that area are owned and maintained appropriately. Ensuring that product features are built in a way that scales, is cost-effective, and is in line with the vision for a product area. Ensuring the appropriate level of quality and resilience, with a specific focus on reducing system incidents and improving stability. Ensuring appropriate tech debt is prioritised to support sustainable delivery. Potentially managing a squad (team) as well. 🧠 What you’ll bring to the party: You’ll be a strong fit if you have experience leading engineering teams across multiple squads, teams or product areas in a complex product environment. A collaborative product and engineering mindset: you care about customer outcomes, product strategy, technical quality and the people needed to make the work real. Strong judgement in ambiguity: you can separate urgent from important, make trade-offs explicit and help teams move without pretending all uncertainty has disappeared. A track record of influencing beyond your reporting line and team, building trust with senior stakeholders and helping teams reach decisions when ownership is shared. A bias for action and improvement: when you see a recurring issue, you turn it into the smallest useful action that starts making the system better. Reliability in driving initiatives: people can trust that when you take ownership, the work keeps moving, dependencies are managed and decisions are followed through. Strong people leadership practice, including coaching, direct feedback, performance management, delegation, psychological safety and development of future leaders. Are you ready for a career with us? title: Senior Data Scientist
description: Who we are: We're one of Europe's fastest-growing fintech companies – on a mission to create the world's most empowering way to pay. We launched the product in 2020 and achieved double unicorn status, valued at $2 billion, and since then have taken on more than 6 million customers. Our mission is to become the best way to pay for anything, anywhere and say goodbye to credit costs for everyone. This is huge. Want to join us? About the Role. We are seeking a talented and experienced Senior Data Scientist to join Zilch’s Risk team, with a focus on developing and optimising advanced models in the Risk space, primarily across credit risk, with additional focus on collections optimisation and fraud detection. You will leverage diverse data sources to support key areas across the business, building production-grade models and decisioning solutions that improve risk outcomes, customer experience, and operational efficiency. This role will involve close collaboration with cross-functional teams, including product managers, engineers, risk strategy, credit, collections, fraud, and other data scientists, to ensure data-driven insights are successfully integrated into product strategies, risk decisioning, and business growth initiatives. This is a hands-on role for someone who combines strong applied machine learning with modern ML Ops practices. We are looking for a data scientist who can take models from exploration through to production, monitoring, and iteration. Key Responsibilities. Work with large and complex datasets to solve a wide array of challenging problems using various analytical and statistical approaches. Apply technical expertise with quantitative analysis, experimentation, data mining, and the presentation of data to develop strategies for our products that serve millions of customers and thousands of merchants. Build, validate, deploy, and monitor robust, scalable machine learning models and model pipelines across the risk lifecycle, including onboarding, affordability, life-time value, credit/default risk, in-life risk, collections, and fraud. Present complex data science findings and methodologies to senior stakeholders clearly and concisely. Apply machine learning methods to solve risk and product-related business problems and enhance our decision-making processes. Contribute to the team’s coding efforts, ensuring best practices in version control, testing, CI/CD, model deployment, monitoring, methodologies, workflows, and tooling. Conduct A/B testing, champion/challenger testing, and experimental analyses to evaluate new features, risk strategies, model changes, and product changes. Partner closely with engineering and platform teams to operationalise models, automate workflows, and improve model reliability in production. Proficiency in SQL, Python and core data science and machine learning libraries, such as NumPy, Pandas and Scikit-Learn. Strong understanding of machine learning methods, their application in real-world scenarios and a keen awareness of their limitations. A strong engineering mindset, with the ability to write clean, maintainable, production-ready code, use version control systems such as Git, and collaborate effectively in a multi-developer environment. A results-driven approach, with the ability to quickly iterate and improve models in production. Knowledge of AI safety considerations, such as bias detection, privacy management, and handling personally identifiable information (PII). Familiarity with software development best practices and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, such as GitHub Actions. title: Senior Product Quality Analyst - AI Voice
description: The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them. We are the Voice Production Team, the creative team behind Spotify’s AI voice experiences. We think about AI voices from a casting perspective — including voice type, age and gender — and from a performance perspective, recognizing that a voice may need to perform differently for DJ than it does for an audiobook recap. We bring expertise in voice casting, direction, recording and production, and work closely with Speak to set the quality bar for AI voice models across experiences including AI DJ, Generative AI Ads, Personalized Podcasts, Agent Voice Chat and more. As a Senior Product Quality Analyst, you’ll bring a dedicated evaluation perspective to the team. You’ll own how we define and measure AI voice quality, bringing together Voice Production’s creative bar, Speak’s technical bar and the wider industry bar. Your goal won’t simply be to determine whether Spotify has the “best” AI voice technology on the market. You’ll help us answer a more important question: is our technology the best at serving Spotify’s specific needs? What You'll Do Own the quality bar for Spotify’s AI voice models, defining what “good enough” means for different products, audiences, languages and use cases. Independently design evaluation rubrics and build an evaluation approach that measures qualities such as naturalness, tone, pacing, pronunciation, accent, audio quality and overall experience. Plan and carry out evaluation campaigns, turning qualitative and quantitative findings into clear recommendations for Voice Production, Speak and product teams. Establish an ongoing evaluation rhythm, including when and how we reassess model quality as our technology and products evolve. Benchmark Spotify’s AI voices against third-party models and competitors to understand where our experiences lead, where they differ and where there are opportunities to improve. Help determine appropriate quality trade-offs as Spotify expands into additional languages and regions, considering the product use case and needs of each market. Partner closely with voice experts, machine learning teams, product partners and vendors to maintain a consistent quality bar across demanding and sometimes competing priorities. Surface the most meaningful gaps in model performance and use evaluation insights to help influence future research and technical priorities. Who You Are You have experience in product quality, evaluation, data curation or a closely related field where human judgment is used to assess model or product performance. You know how to independently define evaluation criteria and turn subjective qualities into clear, repeatable rubrics. You are comfortable designing and running both qualitative and MOS-style evaluations and synthesizing the results into actionable insights. You have an understanding of voice or audio quality, including qualities such as naturalness, pacing, tone, accent and pronunciation, or the ability to develop that expertise quickly. You have strong judgment and can maintain a consistent quality bar while balancing different product requirements, markets and stakeholder perspectives. You are comfortable working autonomously, identifying what needs to be evaluated and establishing the processes and cadence to make that evaluation useful over time. You communicate clearly across creative, technical and product teams and can act as a reliable point of contact for internal partners and external vendors. You are curious about generative AI, speech technology and the evolving AI voice landscape and can translate changes in the industry into meaningful benchmarks for Spotify. Where You'll Be This role is based in London We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens. At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can. title: Senior Growth Manager,  UK
description: <div class="content-intro"><div class="c-message_kit__blocks c-message_kit__blocks--rich_text"> <div class="c-message__message_blocks c-message__message_blocks--rich_text" data-qa="message-text"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer" data-qa="block-kit-renderer"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper--first"> <div class="p-rich_text_block"> <div class="p-rich_text_section">Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit <a class="c-link" href="http://www.redditinc.com/" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="http://redditinc.com" data-sk="tooltip_parent">www.redditinc.com</a>.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div></div><p><strong>Location: </strong>This role is based out of our London office.<strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>About the Role:</strong></p> <p>As a Senior Growth Manager, UK on Reddit’s International Community team, you will be a key member of a cross-functional team responsible for deepening Reddit’s presence in the market. This is not a marketing role. Rather, you will drive user and ecosystem growth by building and scaling communities, executing local growth initiatives, coordinating cross-functional stakeholders, and leading initiatives that strengthen Reddit’s local ecosystem and user experience.</p> <p>This role combines strategic planning, growth-focused execution, cross-functional influence, market ownership, and community development. In this role, you will have a significant impact on shaping Reddit’s presence and success in the market, driving user and ecosystem growth at scale while strengthening engagement across local communities.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>User & Community Growth Strategies: </strong>Establish and execute comprehensive strategies to grow the user base and nurture local communities. </li> <li><strong>Growth Operations:</strong> Design, launch, and scale local growth programs aimed at strengthening Reddit's ecosystem of users, communities, and contributors. Apply a creative, entrepreneurial approach by continuously testing and evaluating new ideas to reach your objectives.</li> <li><strong>Cross-functional collaboration:</strong> Serve as the local go-to person for providing market insights and local input to cross-functional teams, including Comms, Product, BD, and Marketing. Coordinate the execution of market-specific initiatives across multiple stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Country Data Ownership: </strong>Monitor key country health KPIs and alert the appropriate teams in the event of significant changes (e.g., DAU, Contributions). Analyze performance trends, identify risks and opportunities, and develop action plans accordingly.</li> <li><strong>Local representation: </strong>Serve as a local spokesperson for Reddit, building influential relationships and partnerships both on and off the platform to reach and attract new audiences.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We Expect From You:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience</li> <li>7+ years of experience in user growth, community growth, product operations, or country expansion, with a demonstrated track record of executing growth programs at scale.</li> <li>Entrepreneurial spirit, strong execution skills and an ability to take initiative and drive projects independently.</li> <li>A strong blend of operational, growth, data, and community/content expertise.</li> <li>Experience building communities and/or growing a user base through on-the-ground initiatives.</li> <li>Data-driven and analytical mindset, with proficiency in Excel modeling, working knowledge of SQL, and experience creating scalable processes and automations.</li> <li>Passion for combining systems thinking with data analysis to drive impactful decisions.</li> <li>Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across internal teams, users, content creators, and external partners.</li> <li>Results-oriented mindset with a strong attention to detail and a bias toward execution.</li> <li>Deep understanding of local market culture, including language, current events, politics, customs, traditions, topics of interest, and cultural sensitivities.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Benefits:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support</li> <li>Family Planning Support</li> <li>Gender-Affirming Care</li> <li>Mental Health & Coaching Benefits</li> <li>Group Personal Pension Scheme with Employer match</li> <li>Private Medical and Dental Scheme</li> <li>Income Replacement Programs</li> <li>Bike to Work scheme</li> <li>Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off</li> <li>Generous Paid Parental Leave</li> </ul> <p>Join us in fulfilling our mission of bringing community, belonging, and empowerment to the world, one community at a time. Become a driving force in shaping the future of Reddit's growth and success around the world.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews.</p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable.  We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes.  We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision.  For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our <a href="https://redditinc.com/policies/candidate-privacy-policy">Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors</a>.</span></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve.  Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know.</span></em></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Front End Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong><span data-contrast="none">3058 -  Front-end Engineer - Manchester</span></strong></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none">Role Summary and Impact</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p>At Code, we design and build digital products and platforms for a range of clients.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Front-end Engineer with strong browser-side engineering skills who cares about how interfaces work in practice.</p> <p>You’ll work mainly in TypeScript and React, building responsive, accessible and performant interfaces as part of a multidisciplinary product team. We use application frameworks including React Router and Next.js, but strong foundations in HTML, CSS and JavaScript matter just as much.</p> <p>This is a senior engineering role, so you’ll do more than implement designs. You’ll help shape how interfaces are built, work closely with designers on interaction and behaviour, contribute to technical decisions, and help other engineers improve their front-end skills.</p> <p>You’ll also contribute to how we approach front-end engineering across Code, sharing what works and challenging approaches when there’s a better way to do things.</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none">Skills and Experience</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"335559739":0}"> </span></p> <ul> <li>Build high-quality user interfaces using TypeScript, React, HTML and CSS.</li> <li>Work with React Router, Next.js and similar React application frameworks.</li> <li>Work closely with designers to turn ideas and designs into usable, responsive interfaces rather than simply reproducing static screens.</li> <li>Make accessibility part of the way software is designed and built, not something added at the end.</li> <li>Pay close attention to browser performance, loading behaviour and the experience across different devices and connection speeds.</li> <li>Help shape component architecture and contribute to reusable design systems and shared patterns.</li> <li>Write automated tests at the right level, from component and interaction tests through to browser-based end-to-end testing.</li> <li>Review code, talk through approaches and help less experienced engineers develop their skills.</li> <li>Work alongside other engineers to understand APIs, application behaviour and how the front end fits into the wider platform.</li> <li>Contribute to the front-end engineering community at Code, sharing ideas and helping us improve how we build for the web.</li> <li><span data-contrast="none">Highly competent across core front-end skillsets: HTML, CSS/SCSS, JavaScript (Vanilla) etc.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335559685":426,"335559991":436}"> </span></li> </ul> <p>You’ll have good experience building production web applications and strong browser fundamentals.</p> <p>HTML, CSS and JavaScript matter to us. You should understand how browsers work and be able to build interfaces that are responsive, accessible and robust without relying on a framework to solve everything.</p> <p>You’ll also need solid TypeScript and React experience, with experience working in applications built with React Router, Next.js or similar approaches.</p> <p>Accessibility should be familiar territory. You should understand semantic HTML, keyboard interaction, focus management and the practical application of WCAG when building interfaces. You should also have experience testing interfaces with screen readers and understand how common interaction patterns are experienced by people using assistive technology.</p> <p>Performance matters too. You should be able to investigate and improve things such as loading, rendering, JavaScript execution, images and Core Web Vitals.</p> <p>You’ll need experience with automated testing. The exact tools are less important than knowing what to test and why, but you may have worked with tools such as Vitest, Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright or Cypress.</p> <p>Working well with designers is important. That means understanding the intent behind a design, talking through interaction and responsive behaviour, spotting problems and contributing to the solution rather than waiting for every detail to be specified.</p> <p>Experience with design systems, Storybook, design tokens or shared component libraries is useful, particularly if you’ve helped establish patterns rather than simply consumed them.</p> <p>As a senior engineer, you’ll also be expected to support others. You don’t need to have formally managed people, but you should be able to review work, share what you know and help other engineers develop.</p> <p>We don’t expect you to match every technology we use. We’re more interested in strong front-end fundamentals, good engineering judgement and a genuine interest in building accessible, well-crafted web interfaces.</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none">Life at WPP Media & Benefits</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">Championing Growth and Development</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">We</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">Create an Open environment</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. title: Director, SEO, Global Client Solutions
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>3719 - Director, SEO, Global Client Solutions </strong></p> <p><strong>About OpenMind</strong><strong>: A Leading WPP Media Brand</strong></p> <p>OpenMind by WPP is an integrated agency model drawing on talent from across WPP. It has been created to accelerate the European transformation for Nestlé’s media function. Core to the solution is the advanced best data and technology capabilities, fuelled by WPP’s investment in AI, to maximise the impact of Nestlé media investment.</p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p>OpenMind oversees Nestle's media activity in Zone Europe. With dozens of countries, +450 team members, and regular new product launches, the account is looking for an AI Discoverability Lead to provide strong SEO and GEO leadership for Nestle categories, supporting Nestlé Search Leads and AI Leads. Being above-market, the role offers plenty of variety, with an enjoyable balance between driving growth for brands, strategic consultancy and laying the framework for excellence, ensuring we’re delivering change at scale.</p> <p>This role will spearhead efforts to ensure elevated AI Discoverability across categories. You will be a regional champion of Nestle’s success framework in this space, overseeing the implementation of the theory into both strategic and activation level layers. You will ensure universal understanding of the above at every level of our teams above-market and in-market, partnering with digital specialists, media planners and category leads. You will be a conduit point between teams which impact AI Discoverability, ensuring scopes are aligned in purpose through to effective completion. Operationally, there will be a focus on partnering with categories to ensure each has a respective plan in place which is best-in-class, utilising latest available resources efficiently in a prioritised manner, focussed on the generation of measurable end results.</p> <p>We have a unique opportunity to raise the bar for AI discoverability across ZEUR, working with some of the biggest brands on the planet eager to showcase their supremacy online. As the AI Discoverability Lead in the Above Market Zone team, you’d be leading a group of AI / GEO / Search specialists holding authority across the Zone. You will be partnering with brands to ensure they have a clear strategy in place to maximize on the visibility opportunity available, which will include working with brands at varied stages of digital maturity. A key part of this role is developing your sizeable supporting team of specialists who will be practically involved at every level, crawling sites, assessing data and developing solutions to achieve enhanced AI visibility. You will help drive the education of the wider Local Market teams on the approach to ensure the same principles ring true across the region, driving excellence further still. As such, excellent operational team management is essential to ensure all stakeholders are working in unison towards the strategic vision.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build operational AI discoverability excellence across ZEUR, managing varied stakeholders to ensure the successful running of a significant total client budget across above-market and in-market teams.</li> <li>High-level GEO / SEO KPI management and market governance to effectively track performance across Zone.</li> <li>Dominate the delivery of best in-class strategies at a zone level to maximise performance across Nestle Europe. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>3654 - Associate Director, Video - UK</strong></p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p>We’re looking for an AV Account Director to lead best-in-class AV planning and buying across a portfolio of clients, predominantly Nationwide, Audible and JML.</p> <p>The role is central to delivering market-leading AV strategy across TV, BVOD/VOD, Cinema and YouTube, ensuring excellence across both agency and client investment objectives. Working closely with senior internal stakeholders and client teams, this person will build strong, credible relationships, lead responses to briefs, oversee the delivery of campaigns with rigour and integrity, and help shape future-facing AV recommendations that drive growth for clients.</p> <p>This role requires a strong AV practitioner with excellent planning and buying expertise, commercial acumen, and confident leadership skills. The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining high standards of output across the team, ensuring strong day-to-day account leadership, and helping push AV recommendations from good to great through audience insight, innovation and joined-up thinking.</p> <p>Responsibilities of the role include:</p> <ul> <li>Leading AV planning and buying across clients such as Nationwide, Audible and JML.</li> <li>Delivering best-in-class implementational planning across TV, BVOD/VOD/Online Video, and Cinema.</li> <li>Owning responses to client briefs and ensuring clear, insight-led storytelling underpinned by data and audience understanding.</li> <li>Overseeing the day-to-day investment process for clients, ensuring a sharp and highly efficient approach to value, quality and delivery.</li> <li>Building strong senior client relationships, while maintaining a close connection with day-to-day client contacts.</li> <li>Supporting and developing direct reports through clear roles, stretching goals and engaging career paths.</li> <li>Managing the AV planning and buying team for your brands with an inclusive leadership style and clear direction.</li> <li>Working closely with relevant accountability and investment stakeholders to ensure the highest quality delivery in the most commercially beneficial way.</li> <li>Maintaining close oversight of buying output, with expert judgement on plans and the wider AV marketplace.</li> <li>Ensuring contractual commitments, campaign delivery standards and client guarantees are met.</li> <li>Driving innovation across AV output, including future-facing activation opportunities in addressable TV, video and audio.</li> <li>Proactively forging strong relationships with media owners to unlock opportunities for clients.</li> <li>Contributing to new business pitches and supporting the transition of new clients where required.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <p>At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values:</p> <ul> <li>Be <strong>Extraordinary</strong> by <em>Leading Collectively</em> to <em>Inspire transformational Creativity.</em></li> <li>Create an <strong>Open</strong> environment by<em> Balancing People and Client Experiences</em> by <em>Cultivating Trust</em>.</li> <li>Lead <strong>Optimistically</strong> by <em>Championing Growth</em> <em>and Development</em> to <em>Mobilize the Enterprise</em>.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>Key skills and experience required:</p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong AV planning and buying experience across TV, BVOD/VOD, Online Video, and Cinema.</li> <li>A deep understanding of audience planning and the ability to translate insight into effective AV recommendations.</li> <li>Strong marketplace knowledge, ensuring you’re on top of all relevant industry headlines, viewing trends, content and developments</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Knowledge and experience with key AV tools and booking systems including (but not limited to) MediaExplorer, DDS, AdvantEdge, techedge, Caria, Prisma and Adwords.</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Proven experience leading client accounts and building trusted senior client relationships.</li> <li>Experience managing and developing teams, with a clear and inclusive leadership style.</li> <li>A track record of delivering against client targets, guarantees and investment commitments.</li> <li>Commercially aware, with strong attention to detail across buying quality, value delivery and financial forecasting.</li> <li>Strong understanding of measurement across AV channels, alongside current market challenges and solutions.</li> <li>Comfortable handling complex situations, resolving conflict and proposing clear solutions.</li> <li>Effective delegation and strong team management skills.</li> <li>Confident presenter with the ability to communicate clearly and persuasively to both internal and external stakeholders.</li> <li>Strong negotiator with the ability to influence across clients, media owners and internal teams.</li> <li>Proactive, collaborative and pitch-ready, with a future-focused mindset and appetite for innovation.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media & Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.  </p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. title: Global People & Workplace Specialist (London)
description: As a Global People & Workplace Specialist, you will play a key role in supporting payroll, benefits, and workplace experience for our global team, with a particular focus on our UK-based employees. You will work closely with the People Operations team and cross-functional partners, including Finance, to ensure accurate and timely payroll and benefits administration while also helping create a smooth, engaging, and well-supported workplace experience. Reporting to the Senior Payroll & Benefits Analyst, you will be an integral member of the People Operations team and will support a broad range of high-priority operational initiatives. This role combines detail-oriented payroll and benefits administration with hands-on workplace and employee experience responsibilities, providing essential services that directly impact employees’ day-to-day experience. This is a hybrid role, requiring three days per week in our London office. Responsibilities Manage end-to-end payroll operations in Workday and Deel, including monthly international payroll processing, timesheets, time-off administration, expense approvals, pension remittances, payroll reporting, and related reconciliations Develop, maintain, and continuously improve payroll, benefits, HR, and workplace processes, procedures, controls, and documentation to support accuracy, efficiency, and scalability Ensure compliance with applicable payroll and benefits regulations, including tax, pension, and other statutory requirements Support the day-to-day administration of employee benefit programs, including medical, dental, vision, pension, Cycle to Work Scheme, and other regional benefits Partner on annual benefits initiatives, including renewals, vendor evaluations, employee engagement initiatives, and other benefits-related projects Conduct regular audits of payroll, benefits, HR data, invoices, and related programs, identifying and resolving discrepancies accurately and promptly Partner closely with the People Operations team to ensure accurate and timely processing of new hires, transfers, promotions, terminations, and other employee lifecycle changes Process and validate employee changes related to tax withholdings, benefit elections, direct deposits, and other payroll or HR updates Review, reconcile, and approve payroll-, benefits-, and workplace-related invoices and expenses Source, evaluate, onboard, and manage vendors across payroll, benefits, workplace services, facilities, food and beverage, and employee programs Oversee day-to-day workplace operations to ensure shared spaces are clean, organized, well stocked, and operating smoothly Develop and manage workplace and employee experience programs, including office lunches, snacks, swag, onboarding support, team gatherings, and company events Plan and execute employee events and workplace initiatives that support engagement, connection, and a positive employee experience Lead facilities projects and coordinate maintenance, repairs, office improvements, and other operational needs Monitor office space utilization, manage workplace inventory, and maintain organized systems that can scale as the company grows Build strong cross-functional relationships and serve as an approachable onsite resource for employees, helping connect workplace operations with broader People and HR needs Serve as a primary resource for employees on payroll, benefits, and workplace-related questions, providing timely, thoughtful, and accurate support Requirements 2+ years of experience in payroll, benefits, People Operations, or a related HR operations function, including hands-on responsibility for payroll processing and benefits administration Experience supporting payroll and/or benefits in the UK, with demonstrated ability to manage differing local requirements, vendors, and processes Strong working knowledge of payroll and benefits compliance requirements, including payroll taxes, statutory benefits, pension requirements, and applicable employment regulations in the UK Exceptional attention to detail and demonstrated ability to handle sensitive employee and payroll information accurately and confidentially Strong employee service and communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain payroll, benefits, and HR-related information and resolve employee questions effectively Experience managing external vendors and coordinating across internal teams to deliver payroll, benefits, workplace, or employee programs Ability to manage multiple priorities and recurring deadlines while maintaining accuracy in a fast-paced environment Hands-on experience with Workday or a comparable HRIS/payroll platform, including employee data maintenance, reporting, audits, and payroll-related processes is preferred Experience supporting workplace operations, employee experience programs, facilities, events, or office vendors is a plus Experience with global benefits programs, international payroll vendors, or Employer of Record (EOR) arrangements is a plus Experience supporting a growing or scaling organization is preferred Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience “Friends of Voleon” Candidate Referral Program If you have a title: Head of Compliance Product
description: We're hiring a Head of Compliance Product to lead the products at the heart of Elliptic and define what they become in the age of AI. Compliance is where Elliptic began and where our commercial core sits today. Some of the world's largest exchanges, banks and government agencies rely on our screening, monitoring and investigation products, and the industry they serve is at an inflection point. Compliance teams everywhere are looking to AI to make their work dramatically more efficient, freeing their people to focus on the judgement calls that genuinely need a human, with every automated decision auditable and explainable. Elliptic is building that future with our customers, not just for them, and this role owns it. You will lead the product managers responsible for our core compliance portfolio, spanning wallet and transaction screening, continuous monitoring, on-chain investigations and risk configuration, and you will drive the product side of our agentic compliance programme alongside our design partners. Much of what you build will have no precedent. You will be inventing the category, inside the company with the data, intelligence and customer trust to win it. This is a player-coach role reporting to the VP of Product. You will lead and grow a team of product managers and personally own some of the hardest problems on the roadmap. The product organisation is centred in London with a growing US presence. What you'll do Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for Elliptic's compliance portfolio, and define what these products become as AI reshapes how compliance work gets done. Lead product for our agentic compliance programme : AI capabilities that make compliance work faster and better, with auditability and explainability designed in from the start. Lead, coach and grow a team of product managers. Hire well, develop people deliberately, and set the standard for how a modern, AI-augmented PM works. Developing product talent is a core output of this role, not a side effect. Stay obsessively close to customers, in creative ways : Methods such as design partnerships, analyst shadowing, product instrumentation, and internal dogfooding before anything ships come naturally to you to increase the chances of success. Convert ambiguous market signal into a clear view of what to build and why. Prioritise ruthlessly. Demand will always exceed capacity. Sequence zero-to-one bets against the needs of products customers depend on today, and say yes or no credibly, with reasoning people can engage with. Execute with rigour, raising velocity and quality together. Own outcomes, not shipping dates. Use AI across your own workflow and your team's to learn faster and ship better at the same time, in a domain where mistakes carry real consequences. What this role is not Not a compliance officer role. You are building the products compliance teams use, not running a compliance programme. Not a caretaker role. The core products are successful and deeply embedded; the mandate is reinvention. Not a management-only layer. You will lead product managers and personally do product work on the hardest problems. Who we're looking for 10+ years building software products , including leading and developing product managers, with people who are better because they worked with you. A genuine zero-to-one track record : an ambiguous problem in a complex domain, taken from nothing to a product real users depend on. Depth in financial crime compliance from the product side (transaction monitoring, screening, KYC/EDD or investigations), built inside an exchange, a bank, a fintech or a compliance technology company. Working knowledge of crypto and blockchain as a baseline; deep blockchain analytics experience is a strong plus. AI-native : AI is embedded in how you work and build every day, you have shipped AI or agentic capabilities to production, and you raise the AI capability of teams around you. If AI has not materially changed how you build product in the last two years, this is not the right role. Deep executional rigour : you break complex problems into shippable steps, sweat the details that determine quality, and reliably carry work over the line. High self-sufficiency : you find high-value opportunities no one assigned you, create clarity rather than wait for it, and are comfortable owning a broad remit while the map is still being drawn. Continuous systems thinking : you look for the repeatable system behind every one-off fix, building leverage so each problem solved makes the whole team permanently faster. A data-informed operating style : you instrument what you ship, argue from evidence, and change your mind when the data disagrees. Judgement under ambiguity : you know which decisions to make fast and which to hold open when precedent does not exist. Comfort in regulated, high-stakes environments : you treat trust, explainability and defensibility as features, and operate well at the tension point between innovation and regulatory reality. Restlessness about velocity and quality : you treat "that's just how long it takes" as a claim to be tested. If you're energised by ownership, invention, and building side by side with customers in a high-stakes domain, we'd love to hear from you. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Executive Assistant
description: Metaview is an AI company focused on recruiting. We build AI agents that help world-class companies hire with radically more speed and precision. We automate the toil, and augment the human for companies like Brex, Affirm, Deel, ElevenLabs, and Airtable. Founded by Siadhal and Shahriar after their experiences scaling Uber and Palantir, we’ve raised $110m from top-tier investors including Google Ventures and Insight Partners. It’s still day 0: Now is the time to re-engineer how work gets done with AI at the core, and our toughest challenges still lie ahead. We’re looking for people seeking the hardest, most fulfilling work of their lives. How we work Four principles guide us: Velocity. Optimise for rate of learning. Take action, get feedback, get better. Hospitality. Sweat the experience. Delight customers, candidates and colleagues, even when it's inconvenient. Transparency. Public unless private. Share context openly within the company so people and agents can take initiative. End-to-end. Deliver outcomes, not tasks. Step beyond your job description and see the work through. The role Siadhal's time is a valuable resource at Metaview, and this role protects it. You'll sit next to him in our Shoreditch office and remove the friction and clutter around him, so he can perform at his best and focus his attention on the most important things. You'll be part of the Office of the CEO, working directly with Siadhal (CEO) and Raza (Chief of Staff) as we scale from 80 to 250 people. Key ownership areas: Own Siadhal's time: design his week around the company's priorities and coordinate across customers, investors, the board and US time zones without anything slipping. Be his trusted proxy on email correspondence with customers, investors and candidates. Organise founder projects end to end: talks and podcasts, dinners, events and offsites. Run our London office to the standard of our Hospitality principle. Engineer the admin away with AI, and catch what's falling through the cracks before anyone asks. What you bring We want the very best: people who want to do the greatest work of their lives and have an outsized impact. 3+ years of experience, including supporting a founder or C-level executive at a high-growth company, with outcomes you personally owned. A record of being the best at everything you've done. Highly strategic, with a view on where Siadhal's time should go and the judgement to know what needs him. Locked in and high throughput. You make things happen at a rate that surprises people. Obsessive about detail, and discreet with sensitive information. Clear thinking and AI built into how you work every day. description: About WPP Production We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world. About WPP WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com . A Hybrid working model We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. This role is ideal for a producer with agency or production-house experience who is curious about emerging AI workflows and excited to help shape the future of creative production. The AI Producer will manage projects end-to-end while collaborating with creative, strategy, production, motion, CGI, OOH, and technology teams to deliver high-quality work on time and on budget. The role requires a strong understanding of integrated production workflows, emerging AI tools, and the operational and legal considerations involved in modern content creation. title: Senior Sales Director
description: Life at Plume At Plume, we believe that technology isn't about moving faster, it's about making life's moments better. Which is why we've built the world's first, and only, open and hardware-independent service delivery platform for smart homes, small businesses, enterprises, and beyond. Our SaaS platform uses WiFi, advanced AI, and machine learning to create the future of connected spaces—and human experiences—at massive scale. We now deliver services to over 60 million locations globally and have managed over 3 billion devices on our platform. We're expanding rapidly, pioneering a new category, and we achieved our Series F funding in just four years. Our customers include many of the world's largest Internet Service Providers (ISPs) who look to Plume to help them evolve their smart home offerings while gleaning insights from their own data. With a bias for action and a love for being trailblazers, the team at Plume embodies a combination of relentless curiosity and imaginative innovation. We challenge ourselves to think in ways that other companies don't, work to do what should be done (rather than what can), and if we can't do it exceptionally well, we don't do it. It's how we've assembled a team of world-class builders, thinkers, and doers. And it's how we're reinventing what's possible every day. Role Description: Plume works with Internet Service Providers (ISPs) to run the connected experience inside their subscribers' homes and small businesses. Our platform sits between their network and the people using it, managing WiFi performance, security, device visibility, care and the digital services layered on top. We are used at scale by some of the largest ISPs across North America, Europe, Asia and the Middle East. The UK and Ireland are mature and concentrated markets. The number of ISPs that matter is small, they are well known to us, and most already have an established approach to managing the connected home. Success here depends on building credibility at a senior level, shaping how these organisations think about the experience they deliver to their subscribers, and then proving that value at scale. We are looking for someone who is at their best in a small number of large, complex accounts rather than in a broad prospecting territory. It is a role with real ownership. You will be the face of Plume in the region, working directly with our executive team and with senior leaders at some of the best-known ISPs in the market. Responsibilities: • A named list of UK and Ireland ISPs, covering both new logos and the growth of existing deployments into new services, subscriber tiers and lines of business. • A multi-million-dollar annual quota carried across new business and installed base expansion. • The full cycle: executive access, discovery, business case, technical validation and POC, commercial modelling, procurement, contract, and a clean handover into delivery. You stay accountable through launch. • The relationship map inside each account. Not a single champion, but the CTO, the Chief Product or Consumer officer, the owner of customer care and operations, and whoever holds the broadband P&L. • A virtual team pulled from solutions engineering, product, delivery, finance, legal and executive sponsorship. You direct it. You do not wait for it. • Accurate forecasting. Deals of this size move, and we would rather know early than late. • A clear read on the market: how ISPs in the region are approaching the connected home, where their priorities are shifting, and what that means for our roadmap. You are our eyes in the territory. Qualifications: This role calls for someone who already understands how ISPs buy. Their decision cycles, stakeholder structures and commercial models are specific to the industry, and the experience we are looking for reflects that. • A track record selling hardware, software, cloud or platform solutions directly to ISPs, with evidence of recurring or subscription-based commercial models. Your experience should be with ISPs as the buyer, rather than with a telco's enterprise IT function as one account among many. • Ownership of deals in the multi-million-dollar ACV range, with 9 to 24 month cycles, formal procurement, and an established solution already in place. • Fluency in ISP economics. ARPU and attach rates, churn and retention drivers, cost to serve, contact volumes and handling time, truck roll avoidance, CPE fleet lifecycle and ODM relationships, NPS. You should be able to build a credible business case yourself before a solutions engineer is in the room. • Experience winning business where the customer already had a solution in place, whether bought or built in-house. That is a different commercial conversation, and we place real weight on it. • Existing senior relationships across UK and Ireland ISPs, or a specific and realistic plan for building them inside two quarters. • MEDDPICC applied in practice rather than in theory. Expect to walk us through a live deal from your current role against it. • Comfort operating without a finished playbook. Our product moves, our commercial models evolve, and parts of this territory are still being defined. You will be building as you sell. • Consistent quota attainment, and the ability to explain honestly where you missed and why. • Willingness to travel regularly across UK and Ireland, and occasionally across EMEA. About Plume As the creator of the only open, hardware-independent, cloud-controlled experience platform for ISPs and their subscribers, Plume partners with over 400 ISP customers, including some of the world's largest such as Charter, Liberty Global, and J:COM. Using OpenSync, the most widely supported open-source, silicon-to-cloud framework for smart spaces, Plume's software-defined network allows ISPs to decouple their service offerings from hardware and rapidly curate and deliver new services over a multi-vendor, open-platform architecture. Plume is an equal opportunity workplace that maintains a continuing policy of nondiscrimination in all employment practices and decisions, ensuring equal employment opportunities for all qualified individuals without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy, childbirth or related individual conditions, medical conditions (as defined by state law), military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.
